metadata.notes: Chinese G2P tone sandhi. Runs after dictionary lookup on a pinyin token sequence (syllable = letters + tone digit 1-5, 5 = neutral; '|' = word boundary). Pass order matters: entry normalization, structural neutral tone, yi/bu sandhi, third-tone sandhi, interjections, exit cleanup. Cross-checked against the frontend_rules g2p_sandhi/zh.json reference implementation; see docs/zh_g2p_sandhi.md. pipeline_kind=g2p_sandhi skips TN frontend bookends (no replace_vertical_line_punct on word-boundary '|').

rules.comment: entry: give every word-boundary marker exactly one space on each side
entry: accept the 0-for-neutral convention and canonicalize it to 5
entry adapter for diacritic pinyin: nǐ -> ni3, de -> de5. Already-numbered tokens end in a digit, so the trailing (?= |$) makes this a no-op for them.

structural neutral tone, X-bu-Y: any three-syllable word with medial bu reads it neutral. dui4 bu4 qi3 -> dui4 bu5 qi3 (对不起), cha4 bu4 duo1 (差不多), kan4 bu4 jian4 (看不见), hao3 bu4 hao3 (好不好). Must precede the bu sandhi rule.
structural neutral tone, A-yi-A: kan4 yi1 kan4 -> kan4 yi5 kan4 (看一看). Must precede the yi sandhi rules.
erhua: a word-final er after another syllable reads neutral. hua1 er2 -> hua1 er5 (花儿). The lookbehinds keep the reference implementation's must_not_er_words (女儿/老儿/男儿/少儿/小儿) at full tone.

yi + T4 -> T2: yi1 yang4 -> yi2 yang4 (一样). Guards, in order: (?<!di4 ) keeps the 第一/第一次 ordinal prefix at T1; YI_NOT_WORD_FINAL blocks only word-FINAL lexical yi (tong3 yi1 | ... 统一, wan4 yi1 万一) while still allowing word-medial yi (bu4 yi1 ding4 不一定); YI_KEEP blocks 一月/一日/一号 and 一对一 (yi1 dui4 yi1 only, not isolated 一对 yi1 dui4).
yi + T1/T2/T3 -> T4: yi1 tian1 -> yi4 tian1 (一天), yi1 qi3 -> yi4 qi3 (一起). Same guards as the T4 rule.
bu + T4 -> T2: bu4 shi4 -> bu2 shi4 (不是). The guard keeps word-final homophones such as gan4 bu4 (干部) out of it.
third-tone sandhi over a whole run of T3 syllables; the op needs the entire run because grouping is left-branching inside a word and right-branching across words
a-particle assimilation after -u/-ou/-iu: lu4 a5 -> lu4 wa5 (路啊)
after -ao: hao3 a5 -> hao3 wa5 (好啊). Must precede the generic vowel rule, which would otherwise see the trailing o.
after -a/-e/-i/-o/-ü: ni3 a5 -> ni3 ya5 (你啊)
after -n: han4 a5 -> han4 na5 (汉啊). Syllables in -ng end in g here and are deliberately left alone.
interjection tone: standalone 啊 before ? reads T2 (啊？ -> á). Only exact syllable a5; (?:(?:_ )*) skips preprocess boundaries (嗯 _ ?).
interjection tone: standalone 啊 before ! reads T4 (啊！ -> à). Only exact syllable a5.
interjection tone: isolated 哦 before ! reads T4 (哦！ -> ò). Sentence-final …哦！ keeps o5: requires ^o5 or no syllable/| before o5 (ke2 yi3 | o5 ! unchanged).
interjection tone: isolated 哇 before ! or comma reads T4 (哇！/哇， -> wà). Sentence-final …哇！ keeps wa5 (ke2 yi3 | wa5 ! unchanged).
interjection tone: 嗯 before ? reads T2. Lexicon emits en4/en5; (?:(?:_ )*) skips preprocess boundaries (嗯 _ ?).
interjection tone: 嗯 otherwise takes default_tone 4 when lexicon emits neutral en5. Must follow the question rule.
